relations: The tan dust band along the right horizon advances leftward, thickening toward the ridgeline and progressively veiling the mountains.
The central gray rain column's base merges with the rising dust near the horizon as the front spreads toward center.
The bright sunlit patch beneath the column persists while the dark shelf overhead shifts subtly.
Foreground shrubs and camera viewpoint remain fixed, framing the ongoing storm development.
caption: The video captures a wide desert scrubland beneath a towering, dark storm cloud that dominates the sky. A broad gray column of rain or outflow descends from the cloud base near the center-left and touches the flat ground. Its lower portion is lit by a bright sunlit patch that persists. Along the right horizon, a low mountain range stands partly veiled by a tan dust band that thickens and rises toward the ridgeline. This dust front advances steadily leftward along the ground, spreading toward the center and increasingly obscuring the mountains. The base of the central column blends with the rising dust near the horizon, while the dark shelf overhead shifts subtly. The foreground shrubs and the camera viewpoint appear fixed, framing an ongoing storm process.
